text:
Marta: Quick heads-up: PR #4788 adds a small dashboard preset (cost-by-route + latency bands) and updates trace-hook examples to prefer `trace_id`. Also includes a short Ruby snippet for tracing migration. Need someone to run smoke/linkcheck and confirm formatting. @DevEx Noor?
DevEx Noor: I got this. Paste staging preview?
Marta: https://staging.redwood.dev/pr/4788/preview. Changes: new preset file, tiny before/after illustrative numbers, and Ruby + Rust snippets showing mapping from old `traceKey` -> `trace_id`.
Perf Alex: Can infra run a quick microbench for the numbers? PMs want one-line illustrative figures.
PM Sam: Suggest: "Example (illustrative): median 118ms -> 92ms, p99 295ms -> 255ms, est cost/request $0.0046 -> $0.0039" — with clear caveat.
DevEx Noor: Running docs smoke/linkcheck: `./scripts/docs-smoke.sh --pr 4788 --suite quick --linkcheck`
deploy-bot: deploy queued: docs-staging 4788 -> staging (ETA ~2m)
DevEx Noor: Smoke PASS. Linkcheck: 1 broken anchor to tracehook-deepdive#legacy. Leaving PR note.
Marta: Patched anchor and added a redirect. Also added Ruby example per Perf Alex request:
```ruby
# migration example (Ruby)
# old
span.set_tag('traceKey', ctx[:traceKey])
# new
span.set_tag('trace_id', ctx[:trace_id])
```
and a short Rust mapping for completeness:
```rust
// old
span.set_tag("traceKey", ctx.get("traceKey"));
// new
span.set_tag("trace_id", ctx.get("trace_id"));
```
Perf Alex: Microbench summary (short): median ~22% improvement, p99 ~14% improvement, token cost/request ~11% lower. Added numbers to the preset doc.
PM Sam: Add a one-line migration checklist: 1) Upgrade SDKs to v3.4+ for auto-mapping; 2) If pinned, replace `traceKey` -> `trace_id`; 3) Update dashboard queries/alerts.
DevEx Noor: Re-ran linkcheck -> all green. Pushed a tiny formatting fix to the Ruby code block (commit 1c9f).
Marta: Approved and merged after CI. Backported the migration note to 3.x docs. Closing thread — thanks all! :tada:
